title: The mapping lock keeps the operator's choice
summary: Lock mapping edits becomes an app setting kept on the phone, one value for every link, target and board, changed only by the operator's confirmed press; leaving Settings, another app, a lost reply, a reconnection, Wi-Fi or USB serial, a new target or a restart no longer relock; locked only on a phone that never stored a value; the control usable without a board; unsent edits still dropped. App only, on master; seed 72 later builds its checkbox on this value.
